$description: Tier 2 semantic tokens — light theme (default). Every foreground/background pairing declared here is checked by tools/contrast-validator against contracts.json at build time (TR-07). A pair that fails does not ship.

scrim.$description: Modal backdrop. Decorative — never the sole indicator that content is inert.

placeholder.$description: Still meets 4.5:1. Placeholder is never the sole label (AR-11), but when present it must be readable.

disabled.$description: SC 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls, but AAL meets the ratio anyway — see contracts.json note.

text.$description: Validation error text. Always paired with an icon and text, never colour alone (AR-13).

subtle.$description: PURELY DECORATIVE dividers carrying no information. Exempt from 1.4.11 and excluded from the contracts — documented so the exemption is a decision, not an oversight.

border.$description: The ACTUAL selection indicator. Must meet 3:1 against the page surface (SC 1.4.11) because it is what makes the state perceivable. The bg tint below only reinforces it.

outer.$description: Dark half of the two-tone ring (PRD §10.5). One of the two tones must reach 3:1 against whatever sits behind the control.

inner.$description: Light half of the two-tone ring.
